title: Shape Derivatives for Maxwell's Equations with Nonlinear Boundary Conditions
summary: This paper develops a trace-regular variational framework for time-harmonic Maxwell scattering problems involving pointwise nonlinear boundary and interface responses. We investigate three canonical classes of models: nonlinear impedance, nonlinear perfect electric conductor, and nonlinear transmission conditions. Since the standard Maxwell tangential trace belongs to a space of negative order, the nonlinearities are formulated in refined functional spaces where the tangential electric field admits an $L^2(Γ)$-trace.
